gold.title: Task-collision rule (not archived + same project + case-insensitive name match) is re-encoded at seven sites across two f
gold.description: The predicate deciding whether a task name collides — not archived, same project, case-insensitive name equality — is written out separately at seven places across src-tauri/src/lib.rs (2776, 2978, 3900, 5053, 7236) and src-tauri/src/cli_server.rs (967, 2346), most of them added by this PR, including one inside the taken-name closure of the unique-name helper. Three of the sites spell the rule as a wrapped multi-line boolean and vary the receiver, the argument, and which value supplies the project id, so no two are byte-identical. The rule has no single home: a future change to what counts as a collision (say, trimming or Unicode case folding) has to land in all seven at once or they silently disagree. The repository's own reviewer approved the PR but asked for a shared helper on the task list.

candidate.title: The "live same-project duplicate" rule is hand-inlined in 7 places
candidate.description: Duplicate name-collision check exists in 7 locations (lib.rs 2776, 2978, 3900, 5053, 7236; cli_server.rs 2346, 967) with message re-spelled in multiple copies. Future policy changes will apply to only some copies, causing inconsistency in name validation across operations.

promotion_candidates.title: GUI New Task dialog can create duplicate task names
promotion_candidates.description: task_create_sync has no name check; only guards by directory path. Repo-root and imported-worktree tasks have no directory guard. GUI dialog lacks client-side validation (NewTaskDialog.tsx:915), allowing duplicate names in same project.

promotion_candidates.title: Test machine_help_covers_the_surface missing rename command
promotion_candidates.description: Expected-verb list does not include "rename". Test will not catch if rename command is dropped from subcommand tree or machine_help output in future refactors.
